name: Add Trip
description: Create Individual or Shared trips. Shared trips support Manual Shared and Automatic Shared modes, including Return Time and Shared Engine grouping.

tasks.title: Create an Individual trip
tasks.summary: Enter the entry information, client information, route, trip date/time, notes, then submit the trip.
steps: Set Trip Date and Trip Time.

tasks.title: Add a stop to an Individual trip
tasks.summary: Use + Add Stop while building the trip route.
steps: Repeat only when another stop is required.
Enter Dropoff and continue the trip.
keywords: add a stop to an individual trip

tasks.title: Create a Manual Shared trip
tasks.summary: Use Manual Shared when the company wants to build the Shared passenger group manually.
steps: Save Draft if needed or select Submit Shared.

tasks.title: Create Automatic Shared candidates
tasks.summary: Add passengers individually and let the Shared Engine find compatible groups.
steps: Set Trip Date and Pickup Time.
Optionally set Appointment Time, Return Time, and Notes.

tasks.title: Build Automatic Shared groups
tasks.summary: Run the Shared Engine after candidates have been added.
steps: Review the Shared Engine Result before submitting matched groups.

tasks.title: Use Return Time in Automatic Shared
tasks.summary: Return Time creates a return candidate for later matching.
steps: Enter Return Time when a return ride is required.
Add the candidate to the Automatic List.
Review outbound and return matches separately.
keywords: use return time in automatic shared

tasks.title: Save work before submitting
tasks.summary: Use the available draft action when a Shared trip is not ready to submit.
steps: Return later to complete the trip before final submission.
